trans-chuy-bonded-terminal-nurzhan.author: Ruslan K.
trans-chuy-bonded-terminal-nurzhan.text: Queue at gate 2 three hours. New crane since September, still no toilet for drivers.

trans-chuy-bonded-terminal-nurzhan.author: Талант
trans-chuy-bonded-terminal-nurzhan.text: На воротах теперь «Калкан», не старый сторож. Документы смотрят долго, приезжайте с утра.

biz-nurzhan-0968.author: Timur S.
biz-nurzhan-0968.text: Лучшее место в Дастгохе. Пластинки, нормальный кофе, никто не мешает.

biz-nurzhan-0968.author: Aidai
biz-nurzhan-0968.text: Cosy, but the stairs are dark and there is no sign. Cheesecake is good.

biz-nurzhan-0968.author: Earn 500$ a day
biz-nurzhan-0968.text: Work from home with Tulparcoin!!! Write me on Tulpar

biz-nurzhan-0968.author: Viktor Pavlovich
biz-nurzhan-0968.text: Музыка громко, после десяти невозможно разговаривать. Пиво свежее.

biz-talas-3060.author: Bakyt Jr.
biz-talas-3060.text: Atamdın chaykhanası. Eng jakşı palov Talasta!

biz-talas-3060.author: Daniel R.
biz-talas-3060.text: Proper plov, cheap, and the old men at the next table taught me to say rahmat properly.

biz-talas-3060.author: Нина
biz-talas-3060.text: Вкусно, но в пятницу после обеда плова уже нет. Приходите к двенадцати.

biz-talas-3104.author: Hannah
biz-talas-3104.text: Lovely courtyard, kind staff. The market wakes you at 6, bring earplugs.

biz-talas-3104.author: Аскар
biz-talas-3104.text: Чисто, тихо (кроме утра). Карта не прошла, пришлось идти к банкомату.

biz-nurzhan-0670.author: Галина Петровна
biz-nurzhan-0670.text: Три часа в очереди 10-го числа. Талончик из интернета не работает.

biz-nurzhan-0670.author: Erlan
biz-nurzhan-0670.text: Fast on normal days. Never come on the 10th.

biz-iyik-janyl-0282.author: Joldosh
biz-iyik-janyl-0282.text: Almalar arzan, jangak jakşı. Ishembi kelgile.

biz-iyik-janyl-0282.author: Sophie T.
biz-iyik-janyl-0282.text: Amazing walnuts and dried apricots. Some sellers only take som cash.

biz-iyik-janyl-0282.author: CHEAP VIAGRA
biz-iyik-janyl-0282.text: best price online pharmacy no prescription

biz-iyik-janyl-0282.author: Аня
biz-iyik-janyl-0282.text: Очень много людей по субботам, парковки нет.

biz-nurzhan-0873.author: Sergey K.
biz-nurzhan-0873.text: Всё есть, если знать ряд. Последний ряд дешевле, как и написано.

biz-nurzhan-0873.author: Nurbek
biz-nurzhan-0873.text: Bought a charger, worked for two days.

biz-talas-0979.author: Marat
biz-talas-0979.text: Сделали быстро. Мастер Рустам знает своё дело.

biz-talas-1236.author: Kenji
biz-talas-1236.text: The family cooked for us every night. No English, lots of smiles.

arsha-books.author: Aigerim
arsha-books.text: The best shop in Talas. Climb the stairs, it smells of leather and paper.

biz-talas-x002.author: Mira
biz-talas-x002.text: Fresh kefir every morning and cheaper than Bereke.

biz-talas-x005.author: Bolot 1989
biz-talas-x005.text: I played Köch on the school computer in 1991. Still the best game ever made in Irad.

jilmay-cargo-talas.author: Asel
jilmay-cargo-talas.text: Посылка «в пути» третью неделю. На месте говорят ждите.

jilmay-cargo-talas.author: Kanat
jilmay-cargo-talas.text: Long queue, one window open. Bring your passport, not the e-Irad ID.

biz-talas-0072.author: Aizada E.
biz-talas-0072.text: The only shop in the centre with index cards in five colours. I buy a pack every month for my evening classes and the woman at the till now keeps the green ones for me.

biz-talas-0085.author: Gulmira S.
biz-talas-0085.text: I baked bread for a school canteen for thirty years, so I am hard to please. This lepyoshka is right: crisp at the edge, soft in the middle, and still warm at seven.

biz-talas-0183.author: Begaiym R.
biz-talas-0183.text: Twenty minutes for lunch from the exchange booth and they manage it. Lagman is good, the tea is too sweet, ask for it without.

biz-talas-0143.author: Sooronbai N.
biz-talas-0143.text: Drivers eat here between runs. Fast, plenty, they keep a table by the window for us. If you see a 31 parked outside, one of my cousins is inside.

biz-talas-0073.author: Adilet (Tündük café)
biz-talas-0073.text: We buy our morning pastries here for the café. Never late, never stale, and they let us pay at the end of the week.

biz-talas-0110.author: Elena O.
biz-talas-0110.text: Good bread, honest weight. They open earlier than the bazaar, which matters when you set up a stall at six.

biz-nurzhan-0390.author: Dilnoza R.
biz-nurzhan-0390.text: Our lab comes here on Fridays. The kimchi stew is real and the owner remembers who wants it less spicy.

biz-nurzhan-0405.author: Оксана В.
biz-nurzhan-0405.text: Ну вот, опять: нужный размер шурупов только под заказ. Но продавец толковый и не обманывает со сдачей.

biz-tash-komur-0007.author: Ulan B.
biz-tash-komur-0007.text: Last stop before the Fergana Gateway coming down. Hot shorpo when the chains have been on for four hours, and they let the passengers use the stove to dry gloves.

biz-sary-bulak-x001.author: Sapar I.
biz-sary-bulak-x001.text: The linemen eat here after a shift on the dam lines. Big portions, cheap, and the radio always has the reservoir level on it.

biz-toktogul-0004.author: Ainura A.
biz-toktogul-0004.text: We bring the class here for ice cream at the end of the school year. Clean, kind staff, and the view of the water.

biz-kyzyl-adyr-0004.author: Kubat M.
biz-kyzyl-adyr-0004.text: After ulak on Sunday the whole team ends up here. They don't mind dogs on the porch.

biz-iyik-janyl-0001.author: Gulnara A.
biz-iyik-janyl-0001.text: They keep coal by the sack for the old people on Cathedral Hill, not only by the tonne. My mother is 80 and we cannot store a tonne.

biz-talas-0098.author: Temir A. (Chicago)
biz-talas-0098.text: I came home for the first time since 2007. The teapot sign is the same, the tea is the same, the prices are not. I filled in the feedback card and left it on the table. Five stars.

biz-nurzhan-0127.author: Светлана Н.
biz-nurzhan-0127.text: Торт на 8 Марта взяли здесь, трое детей съели половину до вечера. Свежий, крем не приторный.

biz-nurzhan-0216.author: Artyom Z.
biz-nurzhan-0216.text: Proper canteen like the old days. I eat here before the night coach. Borscht on Thursdays.

biz-talas-0075.author: Gulzat M.
biz-talas-0075.text: Teachers' table after the first of September, every year since 1993 in one café or another. This one is quiet enough to talk.

biz-talas-0039.author: Aidana K.
biz-talas-0039.text: Students from the vet faculty eat here. Cheap, quick, and nobody minds if you come straight from the stables.
